prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE refined, high-fidelity unified design concept for the remote desktop app «асси», combining the two supplied reference images. Image 1 contributes clear personal device navigation and visual recognition of the selected computer. Image 2 contributes a compact graphite material palette, precise typography, restrained mint action accents and quick search. These references are inspiration, NOT layouts to place side-by-side. Produce one coherent original app design for BOTH ordinary users AND IT professionals. This is a visual prototype, not a running app.

Canvas 1536x1024 landscape. Flat front-facing desktop application at left, 72% width, Android phone screen at right 23%, neutral dark backdrop, only minimal outside margins. Small outside title «Асси / устройства и подключения», small footer «Визуальная концепция · демоданные». Desktop and phone must be legible, high quality Cyrillic text. No marketing site, no giant hero headline. Contemporary beautifully crafted professional consumer tool, sophisticated, useful, calm.

Palette: rich graphite #202429 main, slightly darker #171b20 navigation, lighter #2b3036 raised controls, very readable white and warm gray type, pale icy mint #a9f0d1 for primary actions only. Shadows give genuine subtle depth, thin dividers, NO glow, NO giant glossy gradients, NO neon. Cyrillic Manrope-like typography. Spacious enough for ordinary people but dense enough to show several devices.

DESKTOP STRUCTURE:
1. Slim header: «асси» with the simple two-stroke mint symbol from reference 2, a broad search field «Имя устройства или код», quiet theme icon and window controls.
2. Left column, about 220 pixels: heading «Устройства», then clearly labelled groups «Личные» and «Рабочие». Device rows with small consistent outline icons and status dots: «MacBook Pro» selected, «Домашний ПК», «Pixel 9» under personal; «Офисный ПК», «Рабочая станция» under work. A quiet «+ Добавить устройство» action at the bottom. No billing, no avatars of relatives, no “help” language.
3. Main selected-device region: top row title «MacBook Pro», smaller «macOS · Личные», green dot with label «В сети». Under it a TASTEFUL MODEST device render (silver laptop with dark teal abstract wallpaper), taking only the central 35% of this region, not giant. Below device a clear mint main button «Подключиться» and quiet secondary «Передать файлы». Lower area separated with one thin line contains heading «Недавние подключения» and two slim rows «Офисный ПК» and «Рабочая станция», each system label and discreet right-arrow action. A small explicit grid/list switch near «Устройства» makes the interface credible for many devices, no analytics.
4. Bottom utility strip across main app: label «Ваш код», spaced digits «584 209 176», copy icon, and outlined button «Предоставить доступ». Absolutely NO permanent consent checkbox. Consent is granted per request. Do NOT use the phrases «Получить помощь», «Помочь близким», «Мама», «Папа», «Согласен на подключение».

ANDROID:
Same graphite/mint design, small «асси» brand row with theme icon. Search field «Имя устройства или код». Segmented group filter «Все», «Личные», «Рабочие». Primary content is a mobile-efficient LIST of 3 devices, not a giant laptop illustration: selected «MacBook Pro» row has a small tasteful laptop thumbnail, «macOS», status «В сети», mint connect arrow. Next «Домашний ПК», «Windows», «В сети»; «Pixel 9», «Android», «Не в сети». A compact bottom section shows «Ваш код 584 209 176» and wide «Предоставить доступ» button. Bottom navigation «Устройства», «Сеансы», «Настройки». Large clear touch targets. Retain visible text status labels alongside status colors. Offline devices are visibly inactive for connecting.

Result must look like a deliberately designed cohesive shippable interface, not a scrapbook of two earlier images. No real connection metrics or fabricated capabilities as measured claims.
approval: Пользователь приложил исходное изображение и написал: «лучше этого пока не было, делаем егор».
